method.theme_support: Each of the 132 full-body concept-annotation rows was searched for the candidate lexical pattern against body_named_item_phrases, observed_product_type_terms, and nested evidence_terms. Taxonomy labels were not included in the match string. Nonmatches stayed in the denominator.
method.semantic_review: Explicitly evaluated whether each candidate is a distinct product upper concept. Use-case-only candidates were left blank. Counts of one were retained when they named a distinct product category; no minimum n was invented.
method.overlap: Theme evidence may overlap. Unique product count is separately unknown unless store+item key is confirmed.

superseded_legacy_fields.disposition: These older fields conflated the result-row product-identity audit with the full-body acquisition target. They are retained as historical context only; 130 refers to approximate full body texts, not unique products.

theme_support_summary.count_semantics: Overlap permitted. This is body annotation pattern evidence, not unique products or independent posts.
